name: foundationdb-dotnet-skills
description: Agent Skills for building correctly on the FoundationDB .NET client (FoundationDB.Client / SnowBank): key & value encoding, subspaces and the Directory layer, writing custom Layers, transactions and the retry loop, advanced/distributed patterns (change feeds, leases, retention, fencing), the Slice binary toolkit, running/connecting to a cluster (the .NET Aspire hosting & client integrations and the native libfdb_c client), and writing/diagnosing multi-node integration tests on the SnowBank distributed-test framework (the unified test journal).
